summary:
Reviewed w204's fix round: commit d6667395 (scripts/supervise_rounds.py, +4 -1), the only non-work commit between a73ea6b2 (ready -> claimed) and 68829a60 (claimed -> done). It matches the implementer's result.
It fixes 4-review F1 as the 2026-10-27 answer asks: applied_nothing skips trailing failed integrate stages, so an answered proposal whose redraft integrate faulted or gave no change list is routed to integrate again.
Verified that a successful integrate is never the trailing stage of an awaiting-answer proposal, because gate rounds write their own stage directory.
No tests or features changed. tools check is clean and size prints nothing.
One Minor observation: no scenario drives the retry.
